pages.title: The Cellar Can Wait
pages.text: Understand bottle storage and wine age without a long wait.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Check the rack’s accepted bottle size. Wine age affects some effects, while instant effects may not scale; no year-long wait is required.

pages.title: Age a bottle
pages.text: Some wines strengthen with age; instant effects can follow different rules. Inspect a bottle's age and effect without waiting a long time for a quest.

pages.title: Choose a bottle rack
pages.text: Racks accept different bottle sizes. The ordinary single-bottle rack and larger storage variants do not have identical rules.

pages.title: Choose a wine effect
pages.text: Wine can affect jumping, surface movement, defense or item attraction. Sneaking stops magnetic attraction; teleport wine searches forward along your gaze rather than selecting a random guaranteed-safe location.
